name: Greenfinch
lateFeature: Bright yellow primary panel, pale wing edges and yellow outer tail
anatomyNotes: Heavy pale conical bill, olive-green body and grey cheek. Strong yellow wing panel and outer tail remain diagnostic throughout finishing.
